programs.title: Basic Boxing Program
programs.description: Build stance, movement, defense, combinations, strength, and recovery through a complete five-week beginner progression.

weeks.title: Stance and movement
weeks.description: Build repeatable stance, straight punches, movement, and foundational defensive habits.

lessons.objective: Complete boxing workout using the prescribed rounds, repetitions, rest, and linked demonstrations from the canonical plan.

lessons.assessment: Finish the prescribed work, then identify one technique cue to carry into the next session.
lessons.transfer: Apply today’s strongest cue during the final freestyle or independent round.
